title: Director of Marketing

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: Nazdar actively exhibits at major trade shows (PRINTING United Expo 2024, ISA Sign Expo 2024) and positions products around outdoor durability performance claims. The Director of Marketing owns competitive differentiation messaging and go-to-market strategy for their ink systems. Partnering with Tedlar would provide powerful proof points for marketing campaigns: transforming '2 years outdoor durability' claims into '12-20+ years with Tedlar overlaminate' creates a dramatic competitive advantage in fleet graphics, vehicle wraps, and architectural applications. This role would also value the graffiti resistance benefit as a unique selling point for transit, outdoor advertising, and municipal signage customers. Given Nazdar's premium positioning and quality focus evidenced by their awards and longevity, this marketing leader needs differentiation tools that justify higher prices and build brand equity—Tedlar provides exactly that story.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: As Director of Marketing, [Name] owns competitive positioning, product messaging, and go-to-market strategy for Nazdar's ink and coating portfolio. This role shapes how Nazdar's outdoor durability claims are communicated to sign shops, print service providers, vehicle wrap installers, and OEM partners. [Name] likely manages trade show presence (PRINTING United, ISA Sign Expo), product launch campaigns, and technical marketing content that helps sales teams differentiate against competitors. Reports likely to CMO or VP of Marketing, with product marketing managers and marketing communications specialists on the team. Does not own product formulation decisions but influences which product attributes get emphasized in market positioning.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: Nazdar's current ink lines emphasize 2-3 year outdoor durability (270 Series: '2 years outdoor durability,' DCA Topcoat: '36 months vertical outdoor exposure'). Tedlar protective films enable Nazdar to market complete ink+overlaminate systems with 12-20+ year performance claims for fleet graphics, vehicle wraps, outdoor signage, and architectural graphics. Specific applications where [Name]'s marketing campaigns would benefit: (1) Fleet graphics and transportation—Tedlar's graffiti resistance adds unique selling point for transit authorities and commercial fleets dealing with vandalism; (2) Outdoor advertising and billboards—UV protection prevents fading/yellowing that causes premature replacement; (3) Architectural panel graphics—extreme temperature range (-70°F to 230°F) and weather resistance support building facade applications; (4) Premium vehicle wraps—positioning Nazdar+Tedlar as the solution for customers demanding maximum investment protection. The marketing story shifts from 'our ink lasts 2 years' to 'our recommended system delivers 20+ years of proven performance.'
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: [Name] is measured on brand differentiation, competitive win rates, customer perception, and marketing's contribution to revenue growth. Key pain points this role faces: (1) Commoditization pressure—ink suppliers compete heavily on price, making it difficult to justify premium positioning without clear performance advantages; (2) Proof point gap—current 2-3 year outdoor durability claims don't separate Nazdar from competitors in premium segments; (3) Trade show ROI—significant investment in PRINTING United and ISA Sign Expo requires compelling differentiation stories that generate qualified leads; (4) Sales enablement—field sales teams need concrete reasons why customers should choose Nazdar over lower-priced alternatives. Tedlar solves these challenges by providing a dramatic, defensible performance claim (10x durability improvement), graffiti resistance as a unique feature for high-value segments, and alignment with Nazdar's sustainability positioning (EcoVadis Silver, TLMI award) through reduced replacement frequency. This transforms marketing from feature-based messaging to outcome-based value propositions.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Nazdar exhibited at PRINTING United Expo 2024 (September 10-12, Las Vegas) and ISA Sign Expo 2024, indicating active trade show calendar planning. ISA Sign Expo 2025 (April 24-26, Las Vegas) and PRINTING United Expo 2025 (September) represent upcoming opportunities where a Tedlar partnership could differentiate booth messaging and product demonstrations. Nazdar's recent sustainability awards (2024 TLMI Calvin Frost Award, 2024 EcoVadis Silver Medal) create relevant context for discussing how Tedlar's durability reduces waste and supports environmental commitments. The company's OEM partnership announcement with M&R Printing Equipment (2023) demonstrates willingness to form strategic alliances that enhance market position—similar partnership logic applies to Tedlar as a recommended overlaminate solution. Q1 2025 timing aligns with typical marketing planning cycles for H2 trade shows and product positioning refresh.

personalization_hooks.hook: Nazdar's current outdoor durability claims (2 years for 270 Series, 36 months for DCA Topcoat) limit competitive differentiation in premium fleet graphics and architectural graphics segments where customers demand extended warranties
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Open by acknowledging Nazdar's quality positioning and outdoor performance focus, then introduce Tedlar as a strategic partner that transforms their 2-3 year claims into 12-20+ year system solutions—enabling premium pricing and market share gains in high-value applications like transit graphics and building facades where performance matters most

personalization_hooks.hook: Director of Marketing owns trade show messaging for PRINTING United and ISA Sign Expo, where Nazdar competes for attention in crowded ink supplier landscape
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Position Tedlar partnership as a booth differentiation strategy for upcoming ISA Sign Expo 2025—offering live demonstrations of graffiti resistance and UV protection creates memorable proof points that separate Nazdar from commodity competitors and generates qualified leads from customers tired of premature graphic failures

personalization_hooks.hook: Nazdar's recent sustainability awards (2024 TLMI Calvin Frost, EcoVadis Silver top 15% globally) indicate brand commitment to environmental responsibility that needs supporting proof points
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Frame Tedlar's extreme durability as a sustainability story—12-20+ year lifespan means 5-10x fewer replacements compared to standard overlaminates, reducing waste and supporting the environmental positioning that earned Nazdar industry recognition while simultaneously strengthening premium brand equity

recommended_approach: Lead with competitive differentiation angle focused on transforming Nazdar's outdoor durability claims from 2-3 years to 12-20+ years through Tedlar partnership. Position this as a marketing solution, not just a material choice—emphasize how [Name] can use dramatic performance improvements to justify premium pricing, differentiate at trade shows, and enable sales teams to win against lower-priced competitors. Reference Nazdar's sustainability awards to align Tedlar's waste-reduction benefits with their existing brand positioning. Keep technical details minimal in first outreach; focus on strategic marketing outcomes [Name] cares about: stronger competitive positioning, compelling trade show presence, and sales enablement tools that drive revenue growth in premium segments.
